system.description:
Lays blessings of purpose on consenting subjects: a spell for one person's task, a convocation for many, or a lifelong anointing for kings, orders and priests.

Spell. Formidable (12) for a month; Hard (15) for a season; Heroic (21) for a year. Bless one touched person for a named, achievable task: each degree adds a bonus die they can spend on that task.

Ritual. Alignment: Convocational Blessing: Formidable (12) Knowledge, 30 minutes. Anointing: Hard (15) Knowledge, 1 hour, in a consecrated temple after an 8-hour vigil. Invocation: Formidable (12) Persuasion, 1 hour. Convocational: each degree gives every subject a bonus die toward the task. Anointing: each degree lowers the Unleashing Difficulty by 3. Unleashing: Convocational: 6 + 1 per extra subject. Anointing: Very Hard (18); each degree lets a spent Destiny Point once count as burned while serving in the anointed role.

Art of Benediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 92.
system.price: Spent (spell, Convocational Blessing) or Burned (Ritual of Anointing)
system.resonances: None (spell) or ritual regalia and incenses (1 gold piece).
